source.name: Charlton Athletic FC, TodayTix announcement
source.note: Two-year agreement; TodayTix logo on the back of the men's and women's first-team shirts. Confirmed on the 2026/27 home (2 Jul 2026) and away (19 Aug 2026) kit reveals.

note: TodayTix back-of-shirt deal runs from 2026/27, its first on a football shirt.
